title: 1980 object sank in a northern Swedish lake, radar return in the mud
summary: Clas Svahn tells of 1980 object sank in a northern Swedish lake, radar return in the mud, about 1980 to present at Lake 'Damaya', a national park in northern Sweden, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Lake 'Damaya', a national park in northern Sweden

tellings.quote:
I mean in 1980 there was a landing and
an object that um sank in a lake up in
the very north of Sweden called Damaya
>> and we have been there and we have radar
returns that something is in the mud.

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher, Clas Svahn, says that in 1980 an object landed and then sank in a lake called Damaya, in a national park in the far north of Sweden. He says his team has been to the lake and has radar readings showing that something is lying in the mud at the bottom. If true, a physical object from the event could still be there to recover.
